name: Creative Australia
note: Primary AU source. Drupal, server-rendered, not Cloudflare-blocked. Custom paginated parser. Every item is Australian-eligible arts funding.

name: Calendar for Artists
note: Australian art competitions/prizes calendar (The Events Calendar plugin). Covers independent and regional prizes. Community-submitted, so not exhaustive.

name: BNE Art: Opportunities
note: Brisbane Art Guide opportunities listing. 80 pages sorted newest-first. Cards carry title, description and YYYYMMDD deadline. Covers Australian prizes, residencies, commissions not found elsewhere.

name: Artsoz prize registry
note: Reads Artsoz's structured list of major Australian prizes (official URLs + state/medium metadata) and scrapes each official site for live dates. Heaviest source; grows as Artsoz adds prizes.

name: Artshow.com Competitions
note: Clean feed of juried competitions and prizes. Amount and deadline already in each description.

name: Artshow.com International
note: Overlaps the competitions feed; dedup merges identical links automatically.

name: Google: Australian art prizes
queries: Australian art prize 2026 "entries open" OR "entries now open" OR "open for entries" site:.au -artshub.com.au
Australian sculpture prize OR residency 2026 "entries open" OR "open for entries" OR "applications open" site:.au
Australian art prize 2026 acquisitive OR portrait OR landscape OR photography "entries open" OR "open for entries" site:.au -artshub.com.au
note: Daily Google search via Serper API (free at serper.dev, 2500 free searches). Three targeted queries: general prizes, sculpture-specific, and acquisitive prizes by medium. Aggregator domains excluded.

name: Neon Marketplace
note: NSW Government creative sector marketplace. Server-rendered, no Cloudflare. Covers NSW arts commissions, residencies, and funded opportunities.

name: ArtsHub: Opportunities
note: ArtsHub opportunity listings. Cloudflare intermittently blocks; parser handles it gracefully (0 items, no crash). Covers prizes, residencies, commissions, grants across all Australian arts.

name: art-prizes.com
note: art-prizes.com Australian/international prize directory. Single-page card scrape, no detail fetches. Structured: deadlines, prize money, location, eligibility, genre. Site may be sold soon.

name: Instagram: art grants
note: Instagram hashtag search via Graph API. Requires IG_USER_ID + IG_ACCESS_TOKEN in env. Uses 4 of 30/week hashtag quota. High-volume tags use reduced limit to avoid Meta 500s. Silently skipped if no IG credentials.
